product_showcase.label: Product Showcase
product_showcase.description: Clean, professional product reveal for ecommerce or SaaS

shots.prompt: Elegant product floating on a minimal white studio background, slow 360-degree rotation, soft rim lighting, hyperrealistic 4K
Close-up of product details, macro lens bokeh, premium texture visible, cinematic grade

cinematic_landscape.label: Cinematic Landscape
cinematic_landscape.description: Epic hero video for brand pages and splash sections

shots.prompt: Sweeping aerial drone shot over misty mountain valley at golden hour, cinematic, Arri Alexa look
Slow dolly through ancient forest path, shafts of light through canopy, 4K film grain
Time-lapse of clouds rolling over dramatic peak, hero moment, epic orchestral energy

lifestyle_vertical.label: Lifestyle / Social Reel
lifestyle_vertical.description: Vertical format lifestyle content for Instagram, TikTok, Shorts

shots.prompt: Young woman smiling in sunlit cafe, holding coffee cup, candid natural energy, warm tones
Her hands open a phone to reveal the app UI, close-up, satisfied reaction

before_after.label: Before / After Transform
before_after.description: Visual quality comparison — perfect for upscalers, editors, AI tools

shots.prompt: Blurry, low-resolution, grainy footage of a city street, pixelated, degraded quality
Same city street scene, crystal clear 4K, vibrant colors, sharp details, dramatically upscaled

viral_hook.label: Viral Hook (Short)
viral_hook.description: Fast-cut attention-grabbing clip for social ads and first 3 seconds
viral_hook.prompt: Dramatic slow-motion close-up of a person's eyes widening in amazement, colorful light reflections, cinematic, high contrast, punchy colors

explainer_multishot.label: Product Explainer
explainer_multishot.description: Multi-shot narrative explainer for SaaS onboarding or feature demos

shots.prompt: Person frustrated at cluttered desk with multiple screens, dim light, overwhelmed expression
They discover the app UI on screen, bright light washes in, interface appears clean and simple
Same person relaxed, smiling at organized workspace, task complete notification on screen

ecommerce_fashion.label: Fashion / Apparel
ecommerce_fashion.description: Model showcase for clothing, accessories, wearables

shots.prompt: Model walking toward camera wearing premium jacket, editorial fashion photography style, neutral backdrop
Close-up of fabric texture and stitching details, tactile quality, soft natural lighting
